title: VALENCE
description: Ask only for what the asset earns. A smooth pastel B2B lead-capture showcase where a 3D capsule dossier unseals across a Splash Gate, a 1-field Squeeze Page, and a 4-field Lead Capture configurator.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · Three.js 3D · Pill UI · Lenis

sections.title: Splash Page
sections.summary: Intermediary gatekeeping & launch announcement threshold (regional/industry cohort selection + single `"Enter the 2026 Briefing"` button).

sections.title: Squeeze Page
sections.summary: Minimalist single-field email capture (one bold headline, two sentences of copy, and a single pill email input field) trading an address for the *14-Page Executive Digest* and waitlist pass.

sections.title: Lead Capture (Lead Gen) Page
sections.summary: Comprehensive B2B multi-field qualification suite (`Full Name`, `Work Email`, `Company`, `Company Size`, `Role`) paired with verified enterprise social proof, benefit bullets, and a live interactive preview of the gated asset (*68-Page Funnel Architecture Monograph & Custom Benchmark Audit*).

sections.title: Floating Pill Header (`Header.tsx`)
sections.summary: Brand lockup, live 3-format pill switcher (`01 Splash Gate`, `02 Squeeze Page`, `03 Lead Capture`), live unlocked depth badge (`15% → 40% → 70% → 100%`), primary `"Unseal Dossier"` pill CTA, and mobile modal dialog menu.

sections.title: Stage 01 — The Splash Gate (`SplashGateSection.tsx`)
sections.summary: High-impact announcement hero & intermediary cohort selector (`North America · B2B SaaS`, `EMEA & UK · Consent-First`, `APAC · High-Velocity PLG`) with a single `"Enter the 2026 Briefing"` button beside the interactive 3D Pastel Capsule Monolith (`CapsuleCanvas.tsx`).
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: The 3-Format Value-Exchange Matrix (`CaptureMatrixSection.tsx`)
sections.summary: Scroll- and click-linked comparison stage contrasting Splash, Squeeze, and Lead Capture pages across median CVR, field friction, structural anatomy, and use cases.

sections.title: Stage 02 — The Squeeze Fast-Lane (`SqueezeSection.tsx`)
sections.summary: Minimalist single-field email capture on a Pistachio Mint slab. Validating the single email input mints a deterministic `SQ-26-XXXX` pass code, unlocks Chapter 02 in the Gated Asset Preview, and carries the email forward into Stage 03.

sections.title: Live Gated Asset Preview (`AssetPreviewSection.tsx`)
sections.summary: Interactive 4-chapter reader for the *2026 Funnel Architecture Monograph*. Visitors filter live SVG benchmark charts by `Company Size` and `Role` and watch locked chapters unseal as gates are completed.

sections.title: Stage 03 — The B2B Lead-Capture Dossier (`LeadCaptureSection.tsx`)
sections.summary: Multi-field B2B qualification form (`Full Name`, `Work Email`, `Company`, `Company Size`, `Role`) paired with benefit bullets, count-up benchmark stats (`418` funnels, `3.4×` pipeline lift, `94%` routing signal), and verified peer social proof cards. Valid submission mints deterministic Dossier Key `VL-2026-XXXX` and unseals the 3D capsule to `100%`.
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: Funnel Governance FAQ & Colophon (`FaqFooterSection.tsx`)
sections.summary: Benchmark marquee ticker, smooth `grid-template-rows` FAQ accordion, ambient motion pause/resume button, and Plum Ink colophon.
